The binary case of the partition relation below is due to Erd ˝os and Hajnal [4], and the case of
two positive colors is due to Baumgartner and Hajnal [2]. Under MA(ℵ 1), Baumgartner proved

conclusion under the same hypothesis. The question for arbitrary finite palettes in ZFC appears as

Theorem 1.1.For every𝑘 <𝜔, every coloring𝑐:[𝜔 21]2→{0,1,...,𝑘}has a color-0homogeneous

5.Cohen forcing and reflection
For an index set𝐼, letP 𝐼 consist of finite partial functions𝐼×𝜔→𝜔, ordered by extension, with

agree on its root. If one domain occurs uncountably often, restrict to that domain and then to a common

common assignment on its finite root. In either case, the subfamily is pairwise compatible. In particular,
